name: Update Content Note
description: Updates an enhanced Salesforce content note, which can include formatted text and is part of Salesforce Files. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_contentnote.htm) and [Set Up Notes](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sales.notes_admin_setup.htm&type=5).

configurable_props.name: contentNoteId
configurable_props.label: Content Note ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the content note to update.

configurable_props.name: docsInfo
configurable_props.content: [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_contentnote.htm) for more information on available fields.

configurable_props.name: OwnerId
configurable_props.label: Owner ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user who owns the note.

configurable_props.name: Content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: The content or body of the note, which can include properly formatted HTML or plain text.

configurable_props.name: IsReadOnly
configurable_props.label: Read Only
configurable_props.description: Indicates whether the note is read only.

configurable_props.name: useAdvancedProps
configurable_props.label: See All Props
configurable_props.description: Set to true to see all available props for this object.
